# Call of Block

Call of Block is an independent competitive Minecraft PvP shooter and multiplayer server project. The official website is https://callofblock.com/.

## Public pages

- Home and server overview: https://callofblock.com/
- Player statistics and leaderboards: https://callofblock.com/stats/
- Community playtests: https://callofblock.com/playtests/
- Feedback and support: https://callofblock.com/feedback/
- Player help: https://callofblock.com/help/
- Project information: https://callofblock.com/about/

## Official project links

- CurseForge modpack: https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/modpacks/call-of-block
- Modrinth modpack: https://modrinth.com/modpack/call-of-block
- Website source: https://github.com/TheWrongLuke/CallOfBlock-Stat-Tracker
- YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@thewrongluke

Public player statistics are exported by the Call of Block Minecraft server. Account, notification and support-ticket information is private and requires authentication.
